title: KYA Scheme Descriptor v1
description: Off-chain descriptor referenced by IKYASchemeRegistry.Scheme.schemeURI. Holds the KYA principle; the chain holds only its address, hash, mode and verifier. Semantics are immutable per schemeId: a changed descriptor is a new scheme with `predecessor` set.

binding.description: What an assertion under this scheme attaches to: the subject record itself, the party controlling it at issuedAt (invalidated by a controller change / ERC-721 transfer), or a specific code/model/config instance committed to by claimDigest.

kind.description: ordered-level: Ordered-Level Profile (level totally ordered, higher is stronger; minLevel and resolve's highest-wins apply). categorical: level is an opaque code from `codes`, compared by equality. opaque: level MUST be 0; the result is what claimDigest commits to.

codes.description: categorical only: map from level code (decimal string 0-255) to meaning.

description.description: opaque/categorical: what claimDigest commits to and how a relying party interprets it.

dimensions.description: Open vocabulary. Registered initial values: controller-binding, provenance, capability, accountability, behavioral, compliance, runtime-integrity.

levels.description: Ordered-Level Profile only (result.kind == ordered-level). Map from level (decimal string 0-255) to semantics. Level 0 MUST be present and mean 'not verified / failed'.

erc8004Response.description: Value a KYA Bridge SHOULD mirror into the ERC-8004 Validation Registry for this level.

evidenceKinds.description: Open vocabulary. Registered initial values: erc8004-reputation, erc8004-validation, vc-jwt, vc-ld, tee-quote, zk-proof, domain-proof, payment-history.

issuerPolicy.description: Declares who may issue under this scheme. Declarative only — the framework does not enforce it.

publicInputLayout.description: Ordered names of ABI-encoded public inputs. MUST include subjectKey and nullifier. Canonical layout 'kya-public-v1': [subjectKey, nullifier, level, claimDigest, expiresAt, issuerSetRoot, epoch].

publicInputAbi.description: Solidity ABI types matching publicInputLayout, e.g. ["bytes32","bytes32","uint8","bytes32","uint64","bytes32","uint64"].

nullifierScope.description: Both scopes are additionally bound to the admission domain the verifier is called with (Section 5): 'scheme' = (schemeId, admissionDomain), 'scheme-epoch' = (schemeId, admissionDomain, epoch).

proofBinding.description: Context the PROOF (not the credential) is bound to via public inputs the caller supplies to verify(). MUST include schemeId and admissionDomain.

epochGrace.description: How many past epochs a verifier still accepts. The verifier enforces current-epochGrace <= epoch <= current from block.timestamp.

issuerSetRoot.description: Trust anchor the verifier pins (issuer-hiding schemes). A different root is a different verifier and therefore a new scheme version.

credentialBinding.description: Fields the fact issuer's credential commits to. MUST include schemeId and subjectKey.
